name: SHOCO token (reflection deliver()+skim exploit) - bot tx at block position 0, attacker tx at position 15 reverted
race_type_reason: A generic searcher bot's tx at index 0 of block 16440979 runs the same victim calls (router swap, SHOCO.deliver, pair.skim, WETH->ETH) as the attacker's tx at index 15, which then reverted. A local fork replay shows the attacker's tx alone succeeds with the identical gain, and bot-first-then-attacker reproduces the revert.
one_liner: At block 16440979 a generic searcher bot (index 0, 0.092 ETH coinbase) ran the SHOCO deliver/skim exploit calls ahead of the attacker's tx (index 15, reverted) and kept 4.1589 ETH gross, about 4.05 ETH net. Fork replay: the attacker alone would have got the same 4.1589 ETH.

attack_txs.role: attack call 0xb05f303c via Balancer flash loan; reverted with ds-math-sub-underflow at pair.skim after the bot had drained the pair (tip 3 gwei)

mempool_note: In-block evidence only: January 2023 is before the mempool-dumpster archive (starts 2023-08-07). Whether the bot saw the attacker's pending tx or found the bug from the attack contract deployed four minutes earlier (block 16440959) is unknowable. The bot's index-0 placement despite a lower effective gas price (15.61 vs 16.61 gwei) and a 0.092 ETH coinbase transfer suggests bundle-style placement (inferred; Flashbots bundle API is gone).

trigger.note: No mempool first-seen exists. The attacker's contract 0x15d684b4 was deployed in block 16440959 (2023-01-19T12:50:11Z) and its attack tx 0x2f2c3c1c landed in the same block as the bot's tx.

attacker_block_note: Attacker's attack tx 0x2f2c3c1c is in the same block as the bot's, at index 15 (tip 3 gwei, effective 16.61 gwei); it reverted.

loot.gross_loot_method: WETH withdrawn to the bot contract (5.626475735040) minus the ETH it wrapped as working capital (1.467586802214), from the callTracer trace; the pair's WETH was the only asset taken

captured_native.desc: WETH out of the SHOCO/WETH Uniswap V2 pair, unwrapped to ETH in the bot contract

loot.loot_note: bot_net_eth = 4.158889 gross - 0.092062 ETH coinbase - 0.014407 ETH gas (incl. 0.001846 ETH tip) = 4.052420 ETH. The bot contract's balance rose 1.4676 -> 5.5344 ETH across the block (= gross - coinbase). The coinbase payment is 69.4% of the 0.1327 ETH winning bid (70.8% counting the tip, the figure in incident.json). No builder refund in the block. No USD figure is saved for 2023-01-19.

fate.returned_desc: No return or bounty found. The proceeds stayed in the bot contract: its ETH balance is unchanged at blocks 16440979, 16441000 and 16445000 and later moves are not attributable (the contract is a shared 'MEV Bot' used by other EOAs). No public statement found.
fate.return_status_rule: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved

rawref_gaps.why: no saved ETH price for 2023-01-19; not converted

discrepancies: Not a calldata copy: the attacker used a Balancer flash loan and one deliver/skim cycle (36-byte calldata); the bot self-funded 1.4676 ETH and ran 12 skim rounds with 19 deliver calls (7,780-byte calldata, own format, not decoded). The match is the victim-facing call pattern and the identical gross gain.
The attacker's reverted tx cost 0.005252 ETH of gas (incident.json); his forgone gain equals the bot's gross to the wei per the fork replay.
evidence_notes: Fork replay at block 16440978 (incidents/shoco-2023/anvil_replay.json, anvil_attacker_alone_trace.json): the attacker's tx alone succeeds and unwraps 4.158888932826055 ETH of WETH, equal to the bot's gross 4.158888932826055; bot-first-then-attacker reproduces the attacker's revert; attacker-first-then-bot makes the bot revert.

Both txs make the same victim-facing calls: Uniswap V2 router swapTokensForExactTokens WETH->SHOCO from pair 0x806b6c68, SHOCO.deliver (0x3bd5d173), pair.skim (0xbc25cf77) to the caller, then WETH->ETH (incident.json bots[0].replay_evidence). Only these two txs in the block touched the pair or token.

Block 16440979: bot at index 0 (effective 15.61 gwei, coinbase 0.0921 ETH), attacker at index 15 (16.61 gwei, 3 gwei tip, reverted). Winning builder Flashbots delivered 0.1327 ETH; the winning block arrived 843 ms before the slot (race.json).

The attacker's attack contract was created four minutes earlier (block 16440959, tx 0xf656affc), so a pending attack tx, the deployed contract, or independent discovery are all possible sources for the bot (unknowable).
Bot is a generic searcher (contract 0x...660d is a shared MEV bot used by other EOAs), not Yoink or c0ffeebabe.
